numerology_home_intro: Enter your birth date to find your life path number and see exactly how it is calculated — including master numbers 11, 22 and 33.
numerology_read_meaning: Read the full meaning of Life Path {number} →
numerology_result_note: For entertainment and self-reflection. Not a prediction of the future.
numerology_summary_1: Life Path 1 is associated with initiative: turning an intention into a first step and taking ownership of it, while leaving room for other people's input.
numerology_summary_2: Life Path 2 is associated with cooperation: listening closely, building agreement and noticing what a situation needs from each person involved.
numerology_summary_3: Life Path 3 is associated with expression: sharing ideas through words, humour and creative work, and finishing what you start.
numerology_summary_4: Life Path 4 is associated with structure: steady routines, careful planning and work that holds up over time.
numerology_summary_5: Life Path 5 is associated with change: curiosity, variety and learning by trying things, balanced with commitments you choose to keep.
numerology_summary_6: Life Path 6 is associated with care: responsibility for home, community and the people around you, with boundaries that protect your own needs.
numerology_summary_7: Life Path 7 is associated with inquiry: research, reflection and time alone to test ideas before sharing them.
numerology_summary_8: Life Path 8 is associated with resources: organising money, time and effort, and using influence in ways other people can trust.
numerology_summary_9: Life Path 9 is associated with completion: wide perspective, generosity and knowing when a chapter is finished.
numerology_summary_11: Life Path 11 is a master number associated with insight: intuition and ideas that inspire others, grounded by the cooperative themes of 2.
numerology_summary_22: Life Path 22 is a master number associated with building: large plans made practical, step by step, with the structural themes of 4.
numerology_summary_33: Life Path 33 is a master number associated with service: teaching and caring for others, with the responsible themes of 6.
numerology_calc_intro: Enter your birth date, and optionally your full name, to see the six core numbers of a Pythagorean numerology chart. Every number shows how it was calculated.
numerology_name_invalid: Only Latin letters are supported (A–Z, accents allowed, with spaces, apostrophes or hyphens). Your date-based numbers are still shown.
numerology_name_required: Enter a name using Latin letters.
numerology_desc_life_path: From your full birth date: month, day and year reduced separately, then added and reduced again.
numerology_desc_expression: From every letter of your name, using the Pythagorean table (A = 1 … I = 9, then J = 1 again).
numerology_desc_soul_urge: From the vowels of your name (A, E, I, O, U, and Y when neither neighbouring letter is a vowel).
numerology_desc_personality: From the consonants of your name.
numerology_desc_birthday: From the day of the month you were born; 11 and 22 are kept.
numerology_desc_personal_year: Birth month + birth day + the current year on your device, reduced.
numerology_chart_intro: The numerology chart places every digit of your birth date on a 3×3 grid. Repeated digits stack up and empty squares show missing numbers. Add your name to see a second grid built from its letters.
numerology_chart_birth_desc: Each square counts how often that digit appears in your birth date. Zeros are not placed on the grid.
numerology_chart_name_desc: Each square counts how many letters of your name have that value.
numerology_chart_missing_none: None — every digit from 1 to 9 appears.
numerology_chart_repeated_none: No digit appears more than once.
numerology_name_intro: Convert the letters of your name into numbers with the Pythagorean table. Accented letters count as their base letter, and every total is shown before it is reduced.
numerology_compat_intro: Enter two birth dates to compare life path numbers. The level comes from a fixed table that summarises common numerology traditions — read it as a conversation starter, not a verdict on a relationship.
numerology_compat_explain_high: The table rates {left} and {right} as a high match: {leftTheme} and {rightTheme} are usually described as reinforcing each other. Shared values still have to be shown in how you plan, decide and repair disagreements.
numerology_compat_explain_medium: The table rates {left} and {right} as a medium match: {leftTheme} and {rightTheme} can complement each other when both people name what they need. Differences here are a topic for conversation, not a warning.
numerology_compat_explain_challenging: The table rates {left} and {right} as challenging: {leftTheme} and {rightTheme} pull in different directions in most descriptions. That says nothing about whether a relationship will work — it suggests which expectations are worth discussing early.
numerology_compat_note: Entertainment use only. A number table cannot measure respect, communication or commitment.
numerology_faq_calc_q1: Do I have to enter my name?
numerology_faq_calc_a1: No. Your life path, birthday number and personal year come from your birth date alone. Expression, soul urge and personality numbers need a name, so they stay locked until you add one.
numerology_faq_calc_q2: Which year does the personal year use?
numerology_faq_calc_a2: It uses the current calendar year on your device, so the result changes on 1 January in your own time zone rather than on a server's clock.
numerology_faq_calc_a3: No. All numbers are calculated in your browser, and the share link only contains your birth date.
numerology_faq_chart_q1: What does a missing number mean?
numerology_faq_chart_a1: It only means that digit does not appear in your birth date. Numerologists read empty squares as themes to explore; it is not a lack of any ability.
numerology_faq_chart_a2: The 3×3 chart has squares for 1 to 9 only, so zeros in the day, month or year are not placed on it.
numerology_faq_name_a1: Most numerologists use the full name given at birth, but any spelling works as long as you compare results using the same one. Changing a name changes the arithmetic, not your future.
numerology_faq_name_q2: How are accents and the letter Y handled?
numerology_faq_name_a2: Accented letters count as their base letter, so Hélène is calculated as HELENE. Y counts as a vowel only when neither neighbouring letter in the same name part is A, E, I, O or U.
numerology_faq_compat_q1: Where do the compatibility levels come from?
numerology_faq_compat_a1: From a fixed 12 × 12 table that summarises common Pythagorean numerology descriptions. The table is symmetric and is the same for every visitor.
numerology_faq_compat_q2: Can a challenging match still work?
numerology_faq_compat_a2: Yes. The table is for entertainment and cannot measure communication, respect or commitment. Use the level as a prompt for a conversation, not as a verdict.
